title: Find out why sweeping with the arrow tool shows no size pill on an Icon picture
goal: Dragging a selection band with the arrow tool on an Icon picture draws the band but no size label under it. The code says this drag should have one. Nobody has checked yet whether this happens on every picture or only on icons.
notes: Reproduced 2026-11-07. Command: Scripts/playtest.sh queue/evidence/2026-11-07-arrow-sweep-pill-walk.json --no-build. Output: [52 drag] FAILED: nothing on the canvas is saying what this drag is doing, and the walk expects "6 × 3". The mid-drag picture shows the dashed band with no pill. Cause unknown: not compared against a build without typing-1-75-into-width-on-an-icon-picture-gives, whose change touches only the words of a pill that exists, not whether one shows (dragReadoutSubject is unchanged). drag-readout-walk passes, but it sweeps with rectSelect, not the arrow tool.
acceptance: The same sweep is tried on an ordinary picture and an Icon picture, and the result is written in the task log
Either the band shows its size in the picture's own numbers, or the log says why it should not

log.note: Tried the same sweep five ways (walks in /tmp, same drag as the evidence walk). Ordinary picture, rectangle picked: pill reads "203 × 131". Icon, nothing picked: pill reads "6 × 3". Icon, rectangle picked: pill reads "6 × 3". Icon, pen path picked: NO pill. Ordinary picture, pen path picked: NO pill. So it is not about icons at all: it is a pen path being picked.

Cause: with a path picked and its points showing, a press on bare canvas with the arrow tool starts a band over the path's POINTS (pathPointSweep, CanvasPathEdit.beginPathPointSweep), not the layer band (marquee). It is drawn the same way, but dragReadoutSubject (CanvasDragReadout.swift) had no branch for it, so nothing was said.

Fix: dragReadoutSubject now reads the points band too, as a sweep, once it has travelled far enough to be a band (same gate as the layer band), reading the drawn box. Icon picture reads in units (6 × 3), ordinary picture in points (203 × 131).

Verified: new walk arrow-sweep-with-a-path-picked-says-its-size-walk ok at Next defaults; the evidence walk queue/evidence/2026-11-07-arrow-sweep-pill-walk.json now ok; 13 walks that read the pill or sweep path points all ok; Scripts/test.sh exit 0 (14,579 + 111 + 179 + 24 tests).

Not icon-specific: any picture with a pen path picked swept a points band the size pill did not know about. The pill now reads that band too (6 × 3 in icon units, points elsewhere). Verified by a new walk at Next defaults, the original evidence walk, 13 related walks and Scripts/test.sh green.
